name: Érpatak (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and green in the ratio 1:6:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Érpatak (a green and yellow shield with a black eagle and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above the name ÉRPATAK in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Érpatak arms with helm, crest and mantling
